description: The channels in a server the bot can see, grouped by category, with type and topic. Filter by type: text, voice, forum, stage, announcement, category. Channels the bot lacks View Channel on are left out by Discord; hidden_from_bot says how many when any are.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

type.description: Only return channels of this type.

name: list_channels
title: List channels
